rows.ja: クラウド基盤・AIモデルの供給元
競合(相手の資料に記載)

relations.text: AWSと複数年の戦略的協業を結び、過去最大となる60億ドルの複数年インフラ利用コミットメントを行う
relations.text_en: Signed a multi-year strategic collaboration with AWS, including a $6B multi-year infrastructure commitment, its largest to date

source.label: Snowflake の発表
source.quote: Snowflake is making a $6 billion multi-year infrastructure commitment to AWS, its largest to date
source.note_en: AWS is a unit of Amazon.com.

relations.text: SnowflakeのプラットフォームはAWSなどのパブリッククラウド上で動いており、事業の大部分がAWS上にある
relations.text_en: Snowflake’s platform runs on public cloud infrastructure including AWS, and a substantial majority of its business runs on AWS

source.label: Snowflake 10-Q(Q2 2027年度)
source.quote: our platform currently operates on public cloud infrastructure provided by Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure (Azure), and Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
source.note: AWS部門の記載で、上場親会社はAmazonです。
source.note_en: Segment-level (AWS); Amazon is the listed parent.

relations.text: AWSは、Snowflakeの全ての市場で競合する大手パブリッククラウド事業者
relations.text_en: AWS is a large public cloud provider that competes with Snowflake in all of its markets.

source.label: Snowflake 10-Q(Q2 2027年度)
source.quote: large, well-established, public cloud providers that generally compete in all of our markets, including AWS, Azure, and GCP
source.note: 競合であると同時に、提携先・供給元でもあります。

relations.text: SnowflakeのプラットフォームはMicrosoft Azureのパブリッククラウド上で動いている
relations.text_en: Snowflake’s platform operates on Microsoft Azure public cloud infrastructure

source.label: Snowflake 10-Q(Q2 2027年度)
source.quote: our platform currently operates on public cloud infrastructure provided by Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure (Azure), and Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

relations.text: Microsoftとの提携を拡大し、Azure OpenAI ServiceをCortex AIに、Cortex AgentsをMicrosoft 365 Copilotに統合
relations.text_en: Expanded the Microsoft partnership, integrating Azure OpenAI Service into Cortex AI and Cortex Agents into Microsoft 365 Copilot

source.label: Snowflake の発表
source.quote: today announced an expanded partnership with Microsoft that will empower enterprises to build easy, efficient, and trusted AI-powered apps and data agents with OpenAI’s models directly in Snowflake Cortex AI

relations.text: Microsoft Azureも、Snowflakeとあらゆる市場で競合する大手パブリッククラウドだ
relations.text_en: Microsoft Azure is also a large public cloud provider that competes with Snowflake in all of its markets.

source.label: Snowflake 10-Q(Q2 2027年度)
source.quote: large, well-established, public cloud providers that generally compete in all of our markets, including AWS, Azure, and GCP
source.note: 競合であると同時に、提携先・供給元でもあります。

relations.text: SnowflakeのプラットフォームはGoogle Cloud Platformのパブリッククラウド上で動いている
relations.text_en: Snowflake’s platform operates on Google Cloud Platform public cloud infrastructure

source.label: Snowflake 10-Q(Q2 2027年度)
source.quote: our platform currently operates on public cloud infrastructure provided by Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure (Azure), and Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
source.note: Google CloudはAlphabetの事業部門です。
source.note_en: Google Cloud is a unit of Alphabet.

relations.text: Google Cloudとの協業を拡大し、Gemini 3をCortex AIに組み込み、共同で市場開拓を進める
relations.text_en: Expanded the collaboration with Google Cloud, bringing Gemini 3 natively into Cortex AI with joint go-to-market

source.label: Snowflake の発表
source.quote: today announced it has expanded its collaboration with Google Cloud, connecting the world’s leading data and AI platform with Google’s advanced AI technologies
source.note: 発表文の日付は2025年1月6日ですが、内容はGemini 3に触れており、日付の誤記の可能性があります。
source.note_en: The printed dateline is January 6, 2025, but the content references Gemini 3, so the date may be a typo.

relations.text: Google Cloud Platformが、Snowflakeの全市場で競合する大手パブリッククラウド事業者となる
relations.text_en: Google Cloud Platform is a large public cloud provider that competes with Snowflake in all of its markets.

source.label: Snowflake 10-Q(Q2 2027年度)
source.quote: large, well-established, public cloud providers that generally compete in all of our markets, including AWS, Azure, and GCP
source.note: 競合であると同時に、提携先・供給元でもあります。

relations.text: Anthropicと複数年・2億ドルの契約を結び、ClaudeモデルをSnowflake Cortex AIで提供し、共同で市場開拓を進める
relations.text_en: Signed a multi-year, $200M agreement bringing Claude models to Snowflake Cortex AI with joint go-to-market

source.label: Snowflake の発表
source.quote: The multi-year, $200 million agreement will not only make Anthropic’s Claude models available in the Snowflake platform to more than 12,600 global customers across all three major clouds

relations.text: Anthropicなどの先端AIモデル提供企業のサービスに依存しており、その価格が費用と粗利益率に影響する
relations.text_en: Relies on frontier AI model providers such as Anthropic, whose pricing influences its costs and gross margins

source.label: Snowflake 10-Q(Q2 2027年度)
source.quote: services provided by these public cloud providers and frontier AI model providers such as Anthropic and OpenAI

relations.text: Summit 26で、Cortex AIでのClaudeの採用拡大を報告。ClaudeがSnowflake Cortex CodeとSnowflake Intelligenceを支えている
relations.text_en: At Summit 26, reported growing adoption of Claude in Cortex AI, with Claude powering Snowflake Cortex Code and Snowflake Intelligence

source.label: Snowflake の発表
source.quote: with Claude powering Snowflake Cortex Code and Snowflake Intelligence

relations.text: OpenAIと複数年・2億ドルの提携契約を結び、OpenAIのモデルをCortex AIで標準提供する
relations.text_en: Signed a multi-year, $200M partnership making OpenAI models natively available in Cortex AI

source.label: Snowflake の発表
source.quote: This multi-year, $200 million partnership agreement cements Snowflake and OpenAI’s commitment to co-innovation and joint go-to-market (GTM) strategies

relations.text: OpenAIなどの先端AIモデル提供企業のサービスに依存しており、その価格が費用と粗利益率に影響する
relations.text_en: Relies on frontier AI model providers such as OpenAI, whose pricing influences its costs and gross margins

source.label: Snowflake 10-Q(Q2 2027年度)
source.quote: services provided by these public cloud providers and frontier AI model providers such as Anthropic and OpenAI

relations.text: LSEGがSnowflakeとの5年間の全社的な協業を拡大し、利用コミットメントを増やす
relations.text_en: LSEG is increasing its commitment to Snowflake under an expanded five-year enterprise-wide collaboration

source.label: Snowflake の発表
source.quote: LSEG is increasing its commitment with Snowflake to support planned growth, migration programmes and customer-facing data services

relations.text: SnowflakeがLSEGのRisk Intelligence World-Checkサービスの利用契約顧客となる
relations.text_en: Snowflake became a licensed customer of LSEG Risk Intelligence World-Check services for onboarding and third-party risk management

source.label: Snowflake の発表
source.quote: Snowflake will also become a licensed customer of LSEG’s Risk Intelligence World-Check services

relations.text: NVIDIAのCUDA-Xデータサイエンス・ライブラリ(cuML、cuDF)をSnowflake MLに統合し、GPUによる高速化を実現
relations.text_en: Natively integrated NVIDIA CUDA-X data science libraries (cuML, cuDF) into Snowflake ML for GPU acceleration

source.label: Snowflake の発表
source.quote: announced a new integration with NVIDIA to accelerate ML workflows directly within Snowflake’s platform

relations.text: Palantir FoundryおよびAIPとSnowflake AI Data Cloudのネイティブ統合で提携
relations.text_en: Partnered on a native integration between Palantir Foundry/AIP and the Snowflake AI Data Cloud

source.label: Snowflake ブログ
source.quote: Today we announced Snowflake's partnership with Palantir Technologies

relations.text: SAP Business Data Cloud向けのSAP Snowflakeソリューション拡張を発表し、ゼロコピーのデータ共有に対応
relations.text_en: Announced the SAP Snowflake solution extension for SAP Business Data Cloud with zero-copy data sharing

source.label: Snowflake の発表
source.quote: announced a new collaboration to enable organizations to seamlessly leverage Snowflake’s AI Data Cloud and SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC) with semantically rich data

relations.text: SAPとSnowflakeは、SAP Snowflakeソリューション拡張とSnowflake向けSAP Business Data Cloud Connectを展開する
relations.text_en: SAP and Snowflake offer the SAP Snowflake solution extension and SAP Business Data Cloud Connect for Snowflake.

source.label: SAP 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: On November 4, SAP and Snowflake, an AI data cloud company, announced the SAP Snowflake solution extension for SAP Business Data Cloud to bring Snowflake’s data and AI capabilities directly to SAP customers

relations.text: ServiceNowとゼロコピー提携を発表し、双方向のデータ共有とSnowflakeからのServiceNowワークフロー起動に対応
relations.text_en: Announced a Zero Copy partnership with ServiceNow for bi-directional data sharing and triggering ServiceNow workflows from Snowflake

source.label: Snowflake の発表
source.quote: today announced a Zero Copy partnership that connects enterprise-wide data to help solve mission-critical problems at scale
source.note: 2025年より前の発表で、その後の更新は確認されていません。
source.note_en: Dated before 2025; no later update was found.

relations.text: SalesforceなどのパートナーとともにOpen Semantic Interchangeの取り組みを主導
relations.text_en: Leads the Open Semantic Interchange initiative together with Salesforce and other partners

source.label: Snowflake の発表
source.quote: in partnership with leading industry partners and ecosystem vendors, including Salesforce, BlackRock, dbt Labs, and RelationalAI, announced a bold commitment to lead the Open Semantic Interchange (OSI)
source.note: 標準化の取り組みへの参加です。

relations.text: SnowflakeのマネージドMCPサーバー経由でサードパーティのデータが接続されるパートナーとして名前が挙がっている
relations.text_en: Named as a partner whose third-party data is connected through Snowflake’s managed MCP Server

source.label: Snowflake の発表
source.label_en: Snowflake press release (Cortex AI for Financial Services)
source.quote: Snowflake’s MCP Server connects third-party data from partners such as FactSet, MSCI, Nasdaq eVestment

relations.text: SnowflakeのマネージドMCPサーバー経由でサードパーティのデータが接続されるパートナーとして名前が挙がっている
relations.text_en: Named as a partner whose third-party data is connected through Snowflake’s managed MCP Server

source.label: Snowflake の発表
source.label_en: Snowflake press release (Cortex AI for Financial Services)
source.quote: Snowflake’s MCP Server connects third-party data from partners such as FactSet, MSCI, Nasdaq eVestment

relations.text: Nasdaq(eVestment)が、SnowflakeのマネージドMCPサーバー経由でサードパーティのデータが接続されるパートナーとして名前が挙がっている
relations.text_en: Nasdaq (eVestment) is named as a partner whose third-party data is connected through Snowflake’s managed MCP Server

source.label: Snowflake の発表
source.label_en: Snowflake press release (Cortex AI for Financial Services)
source.quote: Snowflake’s MCP Server connects third-party data from partners such as FactSet, MSCI, Nasdaq eVestment

relations.text: C3.aiのプラットフォームは、統合を通じて照会する複数のデータソースの1つがSnowflakeだ
relations.text_en: C3.ai's platform queries multiple data sources, including Snowflake, through integration.

source.label: C3.ai 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: allowing queries across multiple sources such as Snowflake, Oracle, Databricks, and others
source.note: 製品統合の言及のみで、正式な提携は記載されていません。
source.note_en: A product-integration mention only; no formal partnership is stated.

relations.text: Snowflakeは、Teradataにとって競合のひとつだ
relations.text_en: Snowflake is one of Teradata's competitors.

source.label: Teradata 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our competitors include established companies within our industry, including AWS, Databricks, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, Snowflake, and others

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
